title: Rama enquires about Kumbhakarna
introduction: Rama sees Kumbhakarna with a colossal body and enquires Vibhishana about a report of him. Then Vibhishana apprises Rama about Kumbhakarna and narrates his story of his getting curse from Brahma, imprecating him to sleep apparently Vibhishana adds that on an appeal from Ravana Brahma relaxed the curse saying that Kumbhakarna would keep sleeping for every six months and then waking up for a day in a year Vibhishana informs Rama that Ravana got Kumbhakarna awakened and is sending now to the battle. Rama then orders Neela the commander-in-cheif to marshal his entire army of monkeys in their appropriate positions in Lanka. On hearing Rama's orders the army of monkeys start their fighting operation.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 61st Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ततो रामो महातेजा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् |
किरीटिनम् महाकायम् कुम्भकर्णम् ददर्श ह
verses.iast:
tato rāmo mahātejā dhanurādāya vīryavān |
kirīṭinam mahākāyam kumbhakarṇam dadarśa ha
verses.translation: Having taken his bow, Rama of great brilliance and prowess, then beheld the bulky Kumbhakarna, adorned with a diadem.

verses.devanagari:
तम् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् पर्वताकारदर्शनम् |
क्रममाणमिवाकाशम् पुरा नारायणम् प्रभुम्
verses.iast:
tam dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaśreṣṭham parvatākāradarśanam |
kramamāṇamivākāśam purā nārāyaṇam prabhum
verses.translation: Seeing that paramount demon, whose appearance was in the form of a mountain and looking like Lord Narayana (the son of the original Man); taking strides across space, (manifested in the form of Trivikrama, who measured the whole universe in a couple of strides) Rama became vigilant.

glosses.meaning: whose appearance was in the form of a mountain
looking like Lord Narayana (the son of the original Man)
long ago (manifested in the form of Trivikrama

verses.devanagari:
सतोयाम्बुदसम्काशम् काञ्चनाङ्गदभूषणम् |
दृष्ट्वा पुनः प्रदुद्राव वानराणाम् महाचमूः
verses.iast:
satoyāmbudasamkāśam kāJṇcanāṇ^gadabhūṣaṇam |
dṛṣṭvā punaḥ pradudrāva vānarāṇām mahācamūḥ
verses.translation: Beholding him again, who was appear like a rainy black cloud and wearing a golden bracelet as an ornament on his upper arm, that huge army of monkeys took to their heels in full speed.

glosses.meaning: who was appearing like a rainy black cloud
wearing a golden bracelet as an ornament on his upper arm

verses.devanagari:
विद्रुताम् वाहिनीम् दृष्ट्वा वर्धमानम् च राक्षसम् |
सविस्मितमिदम् रामो विभीषणमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
vidrutām vāhinīm dṛṣṭvā vardhamānam ca rākṣasam |
savismitamidam rāmo vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha
verses.translation: Seeing the army running away and the demon increasing his body, Rama with a surprise, spoke to vibhishana as follows:

verses.devanagari:
कोऽसु पर्वतसम्काशः किरीटी हरिलोचनः |
लङ्कायाम् दृश्येते वीरः सविद्युदिव तोयदः
verses.iast:
ko'su parvatasamkāśaḥ kirīṭī harilocanaḥ |
laṇ^kāyām dṛśyete vīraḥ savidyudiva toyadaḥ
verses.translation: "This eminent demon, appearing as a mountain, with a diadem and tawmy eyes and looking like a cloud with a flash of lightning, is seen in Lanka. Who is he?"

verses.devanagari:
पृथिव्याम् केतुभूतोऽसौ महानेकोऽत्र दृश्यते |
यम् दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे विद्रवन्ति यतस्ततः
verses.iast:
pṛthivyām ketubhūto'sau mahāneko'tra dṛśyate |
yam dṛṣṭvā vānarāḥ sarve vidravanti yatastataḥ
verses.translation: "He alone with a huge body here on this earth, is appearing like a solitary meteror, by seeing whom all the monkeys are running away hither and thither."

verses.devanagari:
आचक्ष्व सुमहान् कोऽसौ रक्षो वा यदि वासुरः |
न मयैवम्विधम् भूतम् दृष्टपूर्वम् कदाचन
verses.iast:
ācakṣva sumahān ko'sau rakṣo vā yadi vāsuraḥ |
na mayaivamvidham bhūtam dṛṣṭapūrvam kadācana
verses.translation: "Who is he with such a colossal body? Tell me whether he is a demon or an evil spirit. I have not seen such a creature earlier at any time."

verses.devanagari:
सम्पृष्टो राजपुत्रेण रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा |
विभीषणो महाप्राज्ञः काकुत्थ्समिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sampṛṣṭo rājaputreṇa rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā |
vibhīṣaṇo mahāprājJṇaḥ kākutthsamidamabravīt
verses.translation: Thus asked by Rama the prince, who was unweary in action, the highly intelligent Vibhishana replied to Rama as follows:

verses.devanagari:
येन वैवस्वतो युद्धे वासवश्च पराजितः |
सैष विश्रवसः पुत्रः कुम्भकर्णः प्रतापवान्
अस्य प्रमाणसदृशो राक्षसोऽन्यो न विद्यते |
verses.iast:
yena vaivasvato yuddhe vāsavaśca parājitaḥ |
saiṣa viśravasaḥ putraḥ kumbhakarṇaḥ pratāpavān
asya pramāṇasadṛśo rākṣaso'nyo na vidyate |
verses.translation: "He is the powerful Kumbhakarna, the son of Visravasa. He conquered Yama and Indra in battle. Tehre is no other demon, corresponding to the size of his body."

verses.devanagari:
एतेन देवा युधि दानवाश्च |
यक्षाभुजम्गाः पिशिताशनाश्च |
गंधर्वविद्याधरपन्नगाश्च |
सहस्रशो राघव सम्प्रभग्नाः
verses.iast:
etena devā yudhi dānavāśca |
yakṣābhujamgāḥ piśitāśanāśca |
gaṃdharvavidyādharapannagāśca |
sahasraśo rāghava samprabhagnāḥ
verses.translation: "O Rama! He conquered thousands of celestials, demons, a class of demi-gods, serpent demons, ogres, Gandharvas teh celestial musicians, Vidyadharas the celestials artistes and Kinnaras (the semi-divine beings with the human form and the head of a horse) in battle."

verses.devanagari:
शूलपाणिं विरूपाक्षम् कुम्भकर्णम् महाबलम् |
हन्तुम् न शेकुस्त्रिंदशाः कालोऽयमिति मोहिताः
verses.iast:
śūlapāṇiṃ virūpākṣam kumbhakarṇam mahābalam |
hantum na śekustriṃdaśāḥ kālo'yamiti mohitāḥ
verses.translation: "Seeing the mighty Kumbharana with ghastly eyes and a spear in hand, the celestials were not able to kill him, having confused to think that he was yama the god of Death."

glosses.meaning: confused to think ayam kaalaH iti = that he was Yama the god of Death.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकृत्या ह्येष तेजस्वी कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः |
अन्येषाम् राक्षसेंद्राणाम् वरदानकृतम् बलम्
verses.iast:
prakṛtyā hyeṣa tejasvī kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ |
anyeṣām rākṣaseṃdrāṇām varadānakṛtam balam
verses.translation: "This Kumbhakarna, by his very nature, is energetic and mighty. The strength of the other demon-chiefs is attributable to boons (granted on request by gods)."

verses.devanagari:
एतेन जातमात्रेण क्षुधार्तेन महात्मना |
भक्षितानि सहस्राणि सत्त्वानाम् सुबहून्यपि
verses.iast:
etena jātamātreṇa kṣudhārtena mahātmanā |
bhakṣitāni sahasrāṇi sattvānām subahūnyapi
verses.translation: "Soon after his birth, this great-souled demon, afflicted as he was by hunger, ate thousands of living creatures."

glosses.meaning: afflicted as he was by hunger.

verses.devanagari:
तेषु सम्भक्ष्यमाणेषु प्रजा भयनि पीडिताः |
यान्ति स्म शरणम् शक्रम् तमप्यर्थम् न्यवेदयन्
verses.iast:
teṣu sambhakṣyamāṇeṣu prajā bhayani pīḍitāḥ |
yānti sma śaraṇam śakram tamapyartham nyavedayan
verses.translation: "While the living being were being eaten, the frightened people sought refuge with Indra and even reported the matter about him."

verses.devanagari:
स कुम्भकर्णम् कुपितो महेन्द्रो
जघान वज्रेण शितेन वज्री |
स शक्रवज्रभिहतो महात्मा |
चचाल कोपाच्च भृशम् ननाद
verses.iast:
sa kumbhakarṇam kupito mahendro
jaghāna vajreṇa śitena vajrī |
sa śakravajrabhihato mahātmā |
cacāla kopācca bhṛśam nanāda
verses.translation: That Mahendra wielding a thunder-bolt was enraged and struck Kumbhakarna with his weapon of the white thunderbolt. The great souled Kumbhakarna struck by Indra's thunderbolt was quite agitatated at it and roared loudly with anger."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य नानद्यमानस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य रक्षसः |
श्रुत्वा निनादम् वित्रस्ताः प्रजा भूयो वितत्रसुः
verses.iast:
tasya nānadyamānasya kumbhakarṇasya rakṣasaḥ |
śrutvā ninādam vitrastāḥ prajā bhūyo vitatrasuḥ
verses.translation: "Hearing the roar of that Kumbakarna, the demon, wh was howling loudly, the grigthened people were further frightened."

verses.devanagari:
ततः क्रुद्धो महेन्द्रस्य कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः |
निष्कृष्यैरावताद्दन्तम् जघानोरसि वासवम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ kruddho mahendrasya kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ |
niṣkṛṣyairāvatāddantam jaghānorasi vāsavam
verses.translation: "Enraged as he was on Mahendra, the mighty Kumbhakarna then pulled out a tusk of Airavata, Indra's elephant and struck it into Indra's chest."

verses.devanagari:
कुम्भकर्णप्रहारार्तो विजज्वाल स वासवः |
ततो विषेदुः सहसा देवा ब्रह्मर्षिदानवाः
प्रजाभिः सह शक्रश्च ययौ स्थानम् स्वयम्भूवः |
verses.iast:
kumbhakarṇaprahārārto vijajvāla sa vāsavaḥ |
tato viṣeduḥ sahasā devā brahmarṣidānavāḥ
prajābhiḥ saha śakraśca yayau sthānam svayambhūvaḥ |
verses.translation: "That Devendra, tormented by the hit of Kumbhakarna, was burning with rage. The celestials, Brahmanical sages and demons were suddenly aggrieved. Even Indra with his people went to the abode of Brahma the Lord of creation."

glosses.meaning: tormented by the hit of Kumbhakarna
of Brahma the Lord of creation.

verses.devanagari:
कुम्भकर्णस्य दौरात्म्यम् शशंसुस्ते प्रजापतेः
प्रजानाम् भक्षणम् चापि धर्षणम् च दिवौकसाम् |
आश्रमध्वंसनम् चापि परस्त्रीहरणम् तथा
verses.iast:
kumbhakarṇasya daurātmyam śaśaṃsuste prajāpateḥ
prajānām bhakṣaṇam cāpi dharṣaṇam ca divaukasām |
āśramadhvaṃsanam cāpi parastrīharaṇam tathā
verses.translation: "They informed about the evil-mind of Kumbhakarna to Brahma, how he devoured the living creatures, his assault on celestials, the destroyal of hermitages and his taking away of others' wives."

glosses.meaning: the taking away of others' wives.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् प्रजा यदि त्वेष भक्षयिष्यति नित्यशः |
अचिरेणैव कालेन शून्यो लोको भविष्यति
verses.iast:
evam prajā yadi tveṣa bhakṣayiṣyati nityaśaḥ |
acireṇaiva kālena śūnyo loko bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "If he eats away the created beings continuously like this, the world will become desolate just soon after some time."

verses.devanagari:
वासवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वलोकपितामहः |
रक्षांस्यावाहयामास कुम्भकर्णम् ददर्श ह
verses.iast:
vāsavasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ |
rakṣāṃsyāvāhayāmāsa kumbhakarṇam dadarśa ha
verses.translation: "On hearing the words of Indra, Brahama, the great grandfather of the entire world, called for the demons and saw Kumbhakarna too along with them."

verses.devanagari:
कुम्भकर्णम् समीक्ष्यैव वितत्रास प्रजापतिः |
कुम्भकर्णमथाश्वस्तः स्वयम्भूरिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
kumbhakarṇam samīkṣyaiva vitatrāsa prajāpatiḥ |
kumbhakarṇamathāśvastaḥ svayambhūridamabravīt
verses.translation: "Just on seeing Kumbhakarna even Brahma was frightened. Thereafter on restoring his confidence, Brahma cursed Kumbhakarna as follows:

verses.devanagari:
ध्रुवम् लोकविनाशाय पौलस्त्येनासि निर्मितः |
तस्मात्त्वमद्यप्रभृति मृतकल्पः शयिष्यसे
verses.iast:
dhruvam lokavināśāya paulastyenāsi nirmitaḥ |
tasmāttvamadyaprabhṛti mṛtakalpaḥ śayiṣyase
verses.translation: "It is sure that you were created by visravasa for the destroyal of people. On that account, you will be sleeping apparently dead from now onwards."

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतोऽथ निपपाताग्रतः प्रभोः |
ततः परमसम्भ्रान्तो रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
brahmaśāpābhibhūto'tha nipapātāgrataḥ prabhoḥ |
tataḥ paramasambhrānto rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: "Humbled by Brahma's curse, Kumbhakarna then fell down in front of Ravana. Thereupon, the highly perplexed Ravana spoke the following words:"

verses.devanagari:
प्रवृद्धः काञ्चनो वृक्षः फलकाले निकृन्त्यते |
न नप्तारम् स्वकम् न्याय्यम् शप्तुमेवम् प्रजापते
verses.iast:
pravṛddhaḥ kāJṇcano vṛkṣaḥ phalakāle nikṛntyate |
na naptāram svakam nyāyyam śaptumevam prajāpate
verses.translation: "'O Brahma! You are cutting off a well-grown golden tree, just at the time of yielding its fruit. It is not fair on your part to curse your own great grandson like this."

glosses.meaning: It is not fair (on your part)

verses.devanagari:
न मिथ्यावचनश्च त्वम् स्वप्स्यत्येव न संशयः |
कालस्तु क्रियतामस्य शयने जागरे तथा
verses.iast:
na mithyāvacanaśca tvam svapsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
kālastu kriyatāmasya śayane jāgare tathā
verses.translation: "Your words can never prove to be in vain. There is no doubt about it. He will have to sleep certainly. Let some space of time be fixed for his sleeping and waking."

glosses.meaning: let a space of time be created

verses.devanagari:
रावस्य वचः श्रुत्वा स्वयम्भूरिदमब्रवीत् |
शयिता ह्येष षण्मासानेकाहम् जागरिष्यति
verses.iast:
rāvasya vacaḥ śrutvā svayambhūridamabravīt |
śayitā hyeṣa ṣaṇmāsānekāham jāgariṣyati
verses.translation: "Hearing the words of Ravana, Brahma spoke as follows: He will indeed sleep for six months and wake-up for a day."

verses.devanagari:
एकेनाह्ना त्वसौ वीरश्च रन् भूमिम् बुभुक्षितः |
व्यात्तास्यो भक्षयेल्लोकान् सम्वृद्ध इव पावकः
verses.iast:
ekenāhnā tvasau vīraśca ran bhūmim bubhukṣitaḥ |
vyāttāsyo bhakṣayellokān samvṛddha iva pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: "On that single day, this male demon, having starved for six months, will wander over the earth and eat the human race with his month wide open, like an augmented fire."

verses.devanagari:
सोऽसौ व्यसनमापन्नः कुम्भकर्णमबोधयत् |
त्वत्पराक्रमभीतश्च राजा सम्प्रति रावणः
verses.iast:
so'sau vyasanamāpannaḥ kumbhakarṇamabodhayat |
tvatparākramabhītaśca rājā samprati rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Ravana, the king of demons, who got into an evil plight and frightened as he was in seeing your prowess, now got Kumbhakarna awakened."

glosses.meaning: and frightened as he was in your prowess

verses.devanagari:
स एष निर्गतो वीरः शिबिराद्भीमविक्रमः |
वानरान् भृशसम्क्रुद्धो भक्षयन् परिधावति
verses.iast:
sa eṣa nirgato vīraḥ śibirādbhīmavikramaḥ |
vānarān bhṛśasamkruddho bhakṣayan paridhāvati
verses.translation: "This Kumbhakarna the male-demon with a terrific prowess started his tent. The highly enraged Kumbhakara devourincg the monkeys on is way, is running towards us."

verses.devanagari:
कुम्भकर्णम् प्रतीक्ष्यैव हरयोऽद्य प्रदुद्रुवुः |
कथमेनम् रणे क्रुद्धम् वारयिष्यन्ति वानराः
verses.iast:
kumbhakarṇam pratīkṣyaiva harayo'dya pradudruvuḥ |
kathamenam raṇe kruddham vārayiṣyanti vānarāḥ
verses.translation: "Even on merely seeing Kumbhakarna, the monkeys have now fled away. How can the monkeys check him, who is thus enraged in battle?"

verses.devanagari:
उच्यन्ताम् वानराः सर्वे यन्त्रमेतत्समुच्छ्रितम् |
इति विज्ञाय हरयो भविष्यन्तीह निर्भयाः
verses.iast:
ucyantām vānarāḥ sarve yantrametatsamucchritam |
iti vijJṇāya harayo bhaviṣyantīha nirbhayāḥ
verses.translation: "Let all the monkeys be told that it is a kind of machine, advancing forward. By knowing this, they can become fearless by now."

verses.devanagari:
विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा हेतुमत्सुमुखोद्गतम् |
उवाच राघवो वाक्यम् नीलम् सेनापतिम् तदा
verses.iast:
vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā hetumatsumukhodgatam |
uvāca rāghavo vākyam nīlam senāpatim tadā
verses.translation: On hearing Vibhishana's words, which were well-founded to make the monkeys well-inclined to fight the battle, Rama then spoke the follwoing words to neela, the chief of army:

glosses.meaning: to make the monkeys inclined (to fight the battle)

verses.devanagari:
गच्छ सैन्यानि सर्वाणि व्यूह्य तिष्टस्य पावके |
द्वाराण्यादाय लङ्कायाश्चर्याश्चाप्यथ सम्क्रमान्
verses.iast:
gaccha sainyāni sarvāṇi vyūhya tiṣṭasya pāvake |
dvārāṇyādāya laṇ^kāyāścaryāścāpyatha samkramān
verses.translation: "O Neela the son of fire-god. Go, marshalling the entire army. Occupying the door-ways, high-ways and bridges of Lanka, stand ready for operation."

glosses.meaning: O Neela the son of fire-god!

verses.devanagari:
शैलशृङ्गाणि वृक्षांश्च शिलाश्चाप्युपसम्हर |
तिष्ठन्तु सायुधाः सर्वे वानराः शैलपाणयः
verses.iast:
śailaśṛṇ^gāṇi vṛkṣāṃśca śilāścāpyupasamhara |
tiṣṭhantu sāyudhāḥ sarve vānarāḥ śailapāṇayaḥ
verses.translation: "Draw together the mountain-tops, trees and even the rocks. Let all the monkeys with their weapons and rocks in hand, stand ready."

verses.devanagari:
राघवेण समादिष्टो नीलो हरिचमूपतिः |
शशास वानरानीकम् यथावत्कपिकुञ्जरः
verses.iast:
rāghaveṇa samādiṣṭo nīlo haricamūpatiḥ |
śaśāsa vānarānīkam yathāvatkapikuJṇjaraḥ
verses.translation: As directed by Raghavana, Neela the commander-in-chief and the foremost of the monkeys, ordered the monkey-troops suitably.

glosses.meaning: and the foremost among the monkeys

verses.devanagari:
तत्तो गवाक्षः शरभो हनूमानङ्गदस्तथा |
शैलशृङ्गाणि शैलाभा गृहीत्वा द्वारमभ्ययुः
verses.iast:
tatto gavākṣaḥ śarabho hanūmānaṇ^gadastathā |
śailaśṛṇ^gāṇi śailābhā gṛhītvā dvāramabhyayuḥ
verses.translation: Then, Gavaksha, Sharabha, Hanuma and Angada looking like mountains, reached the gate, taking the mountian-tops.

verses.devanagari:
रामवाक्यमुपश्रुत्य हरयो जीतकाशिनः |
पादपैरर्दयन्वीरा वानराः परवाहिनीम्
verses.iast:
rāmavākyamupaśrutya harayo jītakāśinaḥ |
pādapairardayanvīrā vānarāḥ paravāhinīm
verses.translation: On hearing Rama's words, the fearless monkeys started their operation. The heroic monkeys began to torment the enemy-troops with uplifted trees.

verses.devanagari:
ततो हरीणाम् तदनीकमुग्रम् |
रराज शैलोद्यतवृक्षहस्तम् |
गिरेः समीपानुगतम् यथैव |
महन्महाम्भोधरजालमुग्रम्
verses.iast:
tato harīṇām tadanīkamugram |
rarāja śailodyatavṛkṣahastam |
gireḥ samīpānugatam yathaiva |
mahanmahāmbhodharajālamugram
verses.translation: That terrific army of monkeys, with uplifted rocks and tress in their hands, shone like a big collection of gigantic clouds, hanging close to a mountain.

glosses.meaning: with uplifted rocks and trees in their hands
like a big collection of giagantic clouds
